meta.name: The Last Hour
meta.description:
A mysterious young shaman, on the run protecting a secret gift, joins hands with a seasoned city cop to hunt down a dangerous figure from his dark past. But when he falls for the cop's young daughter, he is torn between duty and love.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: A Meeting Of Two Worlds
videos.overview: A tragic encounter in a pine forest brings together Dev, a mysterious shaman and Arup, a seasoned city cop.

videos.title: I Spy With My Little Eye
videos.overview: Dev begins to work with Arup, but when he abuses his gift, he is in for a big surprise.

videos.title: Dark Night
videos.overview: Pari confides in Dev about her mother, and his past almost catches up with him.

videos.title: A Question Of Time
videos.overview: Dev risks his life to save Pari, and Yama Nadu discovers Dev's secret.

videos.title: First Steps Are Always Small
videos.overview: Dev tries to push the limits of his power, but the darkness swallows Pari too.

videos.title: And Then There Was Another
videos.overview: Arup invetigates Pari's case, and Dev's lies are soon laid bare.

videos.title: The Boy Who Cried Wolf
videos.overview: Dev tracks down a crucial suspect, as another slips out of Arup's hands.

videos.title: The Circle Of Life
videos.overview: Dev navigates the labyrinth of life and death, and time and space, to thwart Yama Nadu.
